answer_1.quote: We use annotated QA datasets to construct the hallucination detection datasets and label incorrect LLM answers as hallucinations.

answer_2.quote: For GSM8K dataset ... evaluated by exact match against labels.

answer_3.quote: To assess the correctness of generated answers, we followed prior work ) and adopted the llm-as-judge approach , with the exception of one dataset where exact match evaluation against ground-truth answers was possible.
